entities.summary: Wu Jianmin (1939-03-30, Ch'ung-ch'ing - 2016-06-18) was a prominent Chinese diplomat who played a pivotal role in shaping China's diplomatic landscape. As the spokesman of the Chinese Foreign Ministry, he was instrumental in navigating China's relationships with key international organizations, including the United Nations, the European Union, and the International Olympic Committee. Wu Jianmin's tenure was marked by significant achievements, including the establishment of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization and the Belt and Road Initiative. His diplomatic efforts helped secure China's seat on the UN Security Council and facilitated the country's entry into the World Trade Organization. Wu Jianmin's legacy extends beyond his professional accomplishments, as he also served as a prominent voice for Chinese nationalism and a champion of international cooperation. 'The world is a global village, and China is an integral part of it,' he once said. Wu Jianmin's passing marked the end of an era in Chinese diplomacy, leaving behind a legacy of pragmatism and internationalism that continues to shape China's foreign policy today.
